name: Set Up Trim Paint Protection
intent: Floor protection, wall masking (spray only), and fixture covers (spray only) before trim finish coats. Slower install rates than trim prime setup because the painter is more careful around already-finished walls and ceilings adjacent to the trim.
doctrine: Floor protection rate of 300 SF/hr is intentionally slower than trim prime (1200 SF/hr) because the painter is working around finished wall surfaces and can't drag plastic across them — protection install requires careful corner placement. Fixture cover rate (30 EA/hr) is half the trim prime rate (60 EA/hr) for the same reason. These rates come from the source spec; they may be revisited in Phase 1c if field testing shows them too conservative.
